mapper.sql: id, club_name, club_code, description, purpose, constitution, logo, contact_person, contact_phone, contact_email, founder_id, president_id, member_count, status, established_time, created_time, updated_time
mapper.update: update clubs set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update clubs set member_count = #{memberCount} where id = #{id}
update clubs set founder_id = #{founderId} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from clubs where founder_id = #{founderId} and (status is null or status != 3)

select
from clubs where founder_id = #{founderId} order by created_time desc

select
from clubs where president_id = #{presidentId} order by created_time desc
select id as club_id, club_name, member_count as metric_value from clubs where status = 1 order by member_count desc, created_time desc limit #{limit}

select c.id as club_id, c.club_name, coalesce(count(a.id), 0) as metric_value from clubs c left join activities a on a.club_id = c.id where c.status = 1 group by c.id, c.club_name order by metric_value desc, c.created_time desc limit #{limit}
